title: Termination of the program.
bodyText: The director may terminate the program at any time if the program does not serve its intended purpose, presents a risk to the public health, safety, or welfare, or is no longer necessary.
bodyHtml: [§325-117]  Termination of the program.  The director may terminate the program at any time if the program does not serve its intended purpose, presents a risk to the public health, safety, or welfare, or is no longer necessary. [L 1992, c 152, pt of §2]
